prompt: Which workspace has a member who reacted with a 🚀 (rocket) emoji to the message reporting the $47K monthly cloud bill overage?
binding_note: The reaction, its emoji name, and the target message must all belong to the same reaction record; the reacting user must hold workspace membership in the workspace being identified. A user reacting elsewhere, or a different emoji on the target message, does not satisfy the chain.

roles.facts: T01WORKSPACE ('Test Workspace') is the only stored workspace; all seed users hold workspace_membership rows in it.
roles.reason: The workspace exists and has many members, but no member's reaction record satisfies the full chain (rocket emoji on the specific cloud-bill message), so it fails the identifying condition despite being the sole candidate universe.

roles.facts: Message 1706067472.000000 in #core-infra, authored by U_ROBERT: 'Monthly cloud bill came in. We're $47K over budget, mostly spot instance fallbacks.'
roles.reason: This is the specific message the reaction must land on to satisfy the route; it anchors the REACTION→MESSAGE leg.

roles.facts: U_ROBERT reacts with 'fire' on message 1706067472.000000 (his own cloud-bill message).
roles.reason: Right message, wrong emoji name — the reaction exists but does not use the rocket emoji required by the request.

roles.facts: U_PRIYA reacts with 'rocket' on message 1706028105.000000 (Mateo's Tokyo CDN routing message, unrelated to the cloud bill).
roles.reason: Right emoji, wrong message — the reacted-on message is a different cost/infra topic, not the cloud-bill overage message, so the REACTION→MESSAGE binding fails.

roles.facts: U01AGENBOT9 reacts with 'eyes' on message 1706110000.000100 (circuit-tracer OOM report in #engineering).
roles.reason: Neither the emoji nor the message matches; included as ordinary background reaction activity in the workspace.

roles.facts: U_ROBERT, U_PRIYA, and other neuroflow.ai users hold workspace_membership rows in T01WORKSPACE and are active channel members in #core-infra.
roles.reason: Establishes the WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP→USER leg of the route for the candidate reactors, without which the reaction cannot be tied back to a workspace.

obligations.name: matching_workspace
obligations.description: Identify the workspace(s) having a workspace member whose reaction (specifically the rocket emoji) was left on the message reporting the $47K monthly cloud bill overage. No such workspace exists in the current data because no rocket reaction lands on that particular message.
obligations.scope: Single workspace universe (T01WORKSPACE); evaluate the full membership→user→reaction→message chain against the specified emoji and message.

task_spec.text: Determine which workspace has a member who reacted with a rocket emoji specifically on the message about the $47K monthly cloud bill overage, and report the workspace (or that none qualifies).

access_plan: Locate the cloud-bill-overage message via conversations.history in #core-infra (matches on its distinctive text), then use reactions.get on that message's channel/timestamp to enumerate its reactions and their emoji names. Cross-check each reacting user's workspace membership via users.info/users.conversations. Since reactions.get on the target message returns only a 'fire' reaction (not rocket), and the sole rocket reaction found elsewhere (via search.messages/conversations.history sweep of reactions) is on an unrelated CDN-routing message, no workspace satisfies the full chain.
